698310101.text: I see, I see... So no ninjutsu can disguise someone as a potion bottle after all...

698310102.text: But think about it! A human-sized bottle... Now, wouldn't that be an eye-catching sight?

698310103.text: Really? But making a ninja gadget like that would take forever — and it'd be a real pain, too...

698310107.text: Sayu, what's she pushing on you?

698310108.text: Mm. I ran into Dori while I was shopping, and she dragged me into helping film an "advertisement."

698310109.text: She talked so fast I couldn't even get a word in and bought me lots of snacks and drinks, so I've been listening to her talk this whole time.

698310110.text: Hehe, this little potion is nothing less than the newest, most valuable treasure in Lord Sangemah Bay's portfolio!

698310111.text: Behold! Feast your eyes on the "Ultra-Amazing Miracle Tonic Guaranteed to Make You Taller with Zero Effort!"

698310112.text: The name's a "guaranteed" mouthful, never mind the potion...

698310113.text: C'mon, customers these days don't have the patience for in-depth pamphlets or detailed explanations!

698310114.text: So, I just crammed everything they need to know about the potion and its effects into the name. It's a bit long, sure, but it gets the point across loud and clear.

698310115.text: Sounds nice... But I don't have any Mora. The shrine maiden took all my allowance...
